summary: The repository pins FSharp.Core and disables the SDK implicit library-packs folder. The standalone example projects repeat that source exclusion because qualification copies projects outside the checkout, where Directory.Build.props no longer applies. NuGet.Config clears inherited feeds and names nuget.org. The committed lock records the resulting public-feed FSharp.Core package hash. When updating this dependency, re-resolve every existing lock with the declared SDK and a fresh package cache, inspect .nupkg.metadata source and contentHash, and exercise copied consumers through eng/check.sh and examples/CiPreflight/check.sh. A version match alone does not establish identical package bytes. This source policy extends the earlier SDK hash lesson build/sdk-exact-pin-move-changes-fsharp-core-lock-hash; it does not change Quint/evaluator, Automata, local-candidate or published-consumer identities, and source delivery does not prove publication or installed adoption.
title: Resolve FSharp.Core from the public feed in both repository and standalone consumers
